mapping_check: Every selected CIF matches masked NPZ coordinates

analysis_plan.ipsae_statistic: Minimum of the two directional ipSAE values; also report maximum
analysis_plan.interface_pae: Both directions over residue pairs with heavy-atom distance <5 A; report contact count
analysis_plan.recovery_definition: Native contact recall >=0.5 AND receptor-fitted interface CA RMSD <=2 A
analysis_plan.whole_binder_check: Report binder self-fit CA RMSD; <=2.5 A is a separate provisional fold criterion
analysis_plan.decision: Proceed only if a ranking rule learned on 3DS18 separates matched negatives, recovers interfaces on both seeds, and transfers to held-out 2DS25.5 without changing cutoffs. Whole-binder fold failures block claiming parent qualification.
analysis_plan.uncertainty: Two presumed negatives and published positives do not estimate prospective hit rate. No post-hoc lowering of structural criteria.

predicted_atom_export: Restored predicted sidechains omitted by input atom_resolved_mask, using saved coordinates and pinned canonical atom order. Every retained atom was independently checked against that order before restoration. No imputation or new prediction.

ipsae_provenance.note: The optional ipTM column in raw ipSAE output is unset; use original NPZ ipTM.
